falsePositives.note: bottom nav tabs report 0 px gaps, but T2 passes when hit boxes don't overlap; the nav is a segmented bar, so no ticket

findings.summary: hub: no hamburger top-left and no gold top-right; gold only appears as '5,000 G gold' inside the Continue card (checklist L2)
findings.detail: The Hub has no header at all: the top-left and top-right corners are empty backdrop. The owner's standing ask is a persistent hamburger top-left and gold top-right on every screen (battle already has them). Gold is buried mid-card in '5,000 G gold · 0:00:40 · Cleared 11/40', which also says the unit twice ('G gold'). Fix: give the Hub the same corner pair as battle (hamburger top-left opening Settings / Save & Quit, gold top-right) and drop the gold from the Continue card's stat line.

findings.summary: hub: page overflows the stage and scrolls; the Settings / Save & Quit row is cut off at the fold so both show as bare unlabeled icons, and Save & Quit sits in the bottom thumb sweep (checklist L10)
findings.detail: facts.json puts the 'Settings' and 'Save & Quit' labels at y 2418-2511 and the Osk quote at y 2554-2824 on a 2550-high stage, so the Hub needs a scroll and the last tile row is clipped: only the gear and power glyphs show, with no words (G6). Save & Quit is a session-ending action in the bottom band the thumb sweeps through (L2: nothing destructive there). Fix: fit the Hub to one stage at 100% text (move Settings and Save & Quit into the top-left hamburger per the owner's corner rule, or shrink the cards) so no scroll is needed and nothing is clipped.

findings.summary: hub: tile kind icons repeat: Summon Circle and Craft share the house glyph, Heroes and Merchant share the person glyph (checklist G6)
findings.detail: G6 wants every tappable row to lead with a kind icon that tells it apart. Four of the six Hub tiles reuse two glyphs, so the icon carries no information. Fix: give each tile its own glyph (summon circle, anvil/hammer for Craft, coin/bag for Merchant).

findings.summary: hub: the 'New ability ready' caption under Heroes is 4.21:1 (#8490c3 on #2b3137), below 4.5:1 (checklist X4)
findings.detail: Measured by the uiaudit capture (facts.json hub.text). The caption is informative (it is the Learn nudge), so it needs body contrast. Fix: lighten the tile caption colour on the Manapunk theme (and check the other themes).

findings.summary: stages and every sub-page: header puts 'Tickets' at top-right and gold mid-header next to a '0' diamond button; gold is not in the top-right corner (checklist L2)
findings.detail: The sub-page header reads Back · title · '5,000 G' · [diamond 0] · '0 Tickets' (stages.png; the same four labels are in facts.json for settings, windows, bounties, crucible and bestiary). The owner's rule is gold top-right on every screen, and the hamburger top-left; today Back holds top-left and a zero Tickets count holds top-right. Fix: gold at the right edge, hide zero-value currencies (or move them into the Shop), and decide with the owner whether the hamburger sits top-left beside Back on sub-pages.
findings.verified: GG-T1872 on 1231e5e0: gold now sits at the top-right of the sub-page header on stages, settings, windows, bounties, crucible and bestiary; the zero chips that remain are filed as GG-T1879

findings.summary: stages: locked row reads '28 more stages ahead…' with a literal ellipsis (checklist X9 / owner: no '...')
findings.detail: The owner's standing rule is no truncated names and no '...'. This is a written ellipsis, not a truncation, but it reads as one. Fix: '28 more stages to unlock' (or name the next region and how to open it).

findings.summary: profiles: Rename / Delete float mid-panel detached from the profile row, Delete sits beside Rename with no separation, and '+ New profile' shows a plus twice (checklist L7)
findings.detail: The single profile row is centred at ~43% height, Rename and Delete float ~200 px below it with nothing tying them to the selected row, and the panel has large empty bands above and below. Delete is destructive and sits flush against Rename. '+ New profile' has both a sparkle icon and a typed '+'. Fix: per L7, rows at the top, the row's own actions beside or under it, Delete separated (or behind a confirm in the row's menu), New profile as the footer button bottom-right, and drop the typed '+'.

findings.summary: newprofile / createprofile: the disabled Create and Next labels are 1.44:1 (#2a3047 on #3e4867), below the 3:1 disabled floor (checklist X5)
findings.detail: Measured by the uiaudit capture (facts.json newprofile/createprofile). Both screens open with an empty name so the commit button is disabled, and its label is nearly invisible. X5 asks for at least 3:1 on locked or inactive labels. Fix: raise the disabled button label colour in the menu kit so every theme keeps 3:1.

findings.summary: newgame / load: the three slot rows sit in the top 20% of the screen with a 1462-1617 px empty band below, out of thumb reach (checklist L10)
findings.detail: POL-C9 flags both screens (empty band 1462 px on newgame, 1617 px on load, over 15% of 2550). The slot rows are the only thing to tap and they sit at y ~270-510 of 1312 window px, the hardest reach on a phone held one-handed (owner: thumb reach). The text-entry screens (newprofile, createprofile) are exempt because the keyboard covers the bottom half. Fix: anchor the slot list to the lower half (or make each slot a full-width card that fills the panel).

findings.summary: bounties: the '☠' wanted glyph renders at 28 px, under the 30 px caption floor (checklist X1)
findings.detail: From the UI tree in facts.json (POL-A2 fails 3x on bounties). The screenshot itself came out black (see the capture ticket), so this is from layout data. Fix: draw the glyph at body size or replace it with an icon sprite.
findings.verified: GG-T1872 on 1231e5e0: the wanted skull now draws as a red badge on each bounty portrait, well above the floor

findings.summary: windows: Save / Reset / Delete footer row is off-centre (left inset 194 px vs right 12 px) and puts Delete in the bottom-right commit spot (checklist L7)
findings.detail: From the UI tree in facts.json (POL-C8 'ragged edges: left 194 vs right 12'); the screenshot came out black, so re-check after the recapture. L7 reserves bottom-right for the commit button, but here it is Delete. Fix: Save bottom-right, Delete separated to the left (or behind a confirm), and even insets.
findings.verified: GG-T1872 on 1231e5e0: footer reads Delete left, Reset, Save bottom-right with even insets

findings.summary: uiaudit: title, settings, bestiary, bounties, crucible and windows iphone17pro captures are solid black and splash is mid-fade, so their contrast samples read bg #000000 (checklist §3 capture)
findings.detail: f17cf7da captured these PNGs as a black frame with only the 'Development Build' watermark, though facts.json has their full UI tree. Every contrast sample on them uses bg #000000, so the X4 numbers (e.g. 'Enter the Crucible' 1.03:1, windows 'Confirm' 1.08:1) are not real. Splash was caught mid-fade (copyright 1.11:1). Likely the shot fires during the screen transition fade; tools/uiaudit.py --settle is 1.5 s. Fix: wait for the fade to finish (or until the frame is not uniform) before capturing, then recapture these screens so the GG-T1839 review can be finished for them.
findings.verified: GG-T1872 on 1231e5e0: title, settings, bestiary, bounties, crucible and windows are real frames now

findings.summary: Results: 37 of 54 labels are 24 px, under the 30 px caption floor (Gold, Experience, +214 G, loot names, 'Teach to···'), and 'Teach to···' ends in a written ellipsis (checklist X1, owner: no '...')
findings.detail: facts.json results.text: min and median 24 px. Rows are also spaced ~156 design px apart, so the small text floats in empty bands, and the VICTORY banner is a small 40 px label pinned left instead of a headline. Fix: body size for every row, tighter row height, 'Teach to:' without the dots, and a centred VICTORY headline.

findings.summary: Shared header: zero-value diamond and ticket chips stay up on every page, so on Summon history the gold is pushed off the right edge (1013+163 > 1170 px), shop pages drop the 'Tickets' word to a bare '0', and the Talk bubble is an unlabeled icon 19 px from its neighbours (checklist L2, T2, owner: no truncated text)
findings.detail: Gold now sits top-right (GG-T1858), but the chips before it are fixed width: a long title ('Summon history') clips the gold; Merchant/Blacksmith/Alchemist/Enchantress/Respec show '[diamond] 0 [ticket] 0' with no words; the header chips are 19 px apart (POL-C3 wants 24). Fix: hide a currency chip at zero (or move it into the Shop), keep the label when shown, let the title shrink before the gold does, and keep 24 px between chips.

findings.summary: Bounties / Mercenaries: each card's actions sit on their own rows (Take under every bounty; 3 battles / 5 battles / 10 battles / Haggle stacked), making a mercenary card ~900 design px tall (checklist L7, owner: efficient use of space)
findings.detail: The right half of every card is empty while its buttons stack below. Fix: Take on the card's right edge beside the name; the three hire lengths as one segmented row with Haggle beside it; the flavour quote one tap away (E4).

findings.summary: About: six lines spread over the page with 190-400 design px gaps (Privacy policy y 1434, Terms 1839, Third-party 2241), the legal rows use the settings gear glyph, and Third-party notices has no 'Open' like its siblings (checklist L10, G6)
findings.detail: Rows are distributed to fill the panel. Fix: fixed row height, a document glyph for the legal links, and 'Open' on all three.

findings.summary: Quests: only some rows have a portrait, so the text column jumps between x 110 and x 36, and no row has a kind icon or action though each says 'Talk to them' (checklist G6)
findings.detail: Rows without a giver portrait (What the Frogs Know, Travel Light, Grown, Not Forged) are flush left. Nothing marks a row as tappable or takes the player to the giver. Fix: a placeholder thumbnail (or the place icon) on every row, and a 'Talk' button that opens that giver.

findings.summary: Settings / title: every Settings row leads with the same gear glyph, and on the title menu About and Credits share the book glyph, so the icons tell nothing apart (checklist G6)
findings.detail: G6 wants a kind icon that tells rows apart. Fix: per-row glyphs in Settings (turn mode, difficulty, speed, timer, quality, shake…) or drop the icon on plain setting rows, and give About an 'i' glyph.

findings.summary: Title: the 'Slide. Flank. Strike.' tagline is 4.32:1 and 'v1.0.0' 4.04:1 over the backdrop art with no plate, and the GRIDGAME wordmark is a thin small label (checklist X4, X7)
findings.detail: facts.json title contrast fails. Text drawn over art needs a plate or outline that keeps 4.5:1 on the worst pixel. Fix: a soft dark plate behind the logo block and the version, and a bolder, larger wordmark.

findings.summary: Windows: white preset names on their swatches fail 4.5:1 (Cyberpunk 3.33:1, Ember 3.57:1, Parchment 4.1:1) (checklist X4, X7)
findings.detail: facts.json windows contrast fails. Fix: an outline or dark plate behind swatch labels, or pick black/white per swatch by its lightest stop.

findings.summary: Bestiary: unseen creatures show as near-black silhouettes on a dark tile, and many are framed from the wrong part of the sprite (solid black squares, cropped blobs), so the grid gives no hint of the creature (checklist X6)
findings.detail: Rows 7-8 are almost entirely black tiles; large sprites are cropped to a corner. Fix: frame each silhouette from the sprite's trimmed bounds, and draw it a step lighter than the tile (or outlined) so it reads at 3:1.

findings.summary: Crucible: the Foes row prints all 27 families as a 9-line paragraph inside the intro scroll box, and 'Costs 1 Rested' uses an undefined term (checklist E4, G2)
findings.detail: The intro, rules and foe list share one small scroll box above the team panel. Fix: show the count ('27 families met') with the names one tap away, and link 'Rested' to its glossary entry.

findings.summary: Abilities / results / crucible / header: arrows are tiny glyphs inside circle badges (Move ← / Move →, Continue, Next battle, Enter the Crucible, Back), not filled outlined arrow shapes, and the two Abilities buttons are both labelled 'Move' (owner: arrows drawn as filled, outlined shapes)
findings.detail: The owner's standing ask is arrows drawn as filled, outlined shapes. Today the direction is a ~20 px glyph in a blue disc, and on Abilities the only difference between the two 'Move' buttons is that glyph. Fix: a filled arrow shape with an outline as the button's leading shape, and 'Move left' / 'Move right' labels.

recheck.note: Eye review of the real (non-black) recapture; findings marked fixed where the PNG shows the fix, and new findings added with their tickets.
